jobs.title: Engineering Manager, SSCS: Supply Chain
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab .

An overview of this role
As an Engineering Manager, you’ll guide GitLab ’s dedicated Software Supply Chain Security (SSCS) Add-On engineering team as it develops core capabilities including Dependency Firewall, Build Provenance, Malicious Packages detection, and Artifact Signing. This is a founding management role where you’ll help shape how the team works, partner closely with the Staff Backend Engineer, Product Manager, and SSCS stage management, and turn a defined roadmap into steady, high-quality delivery for enterprise customers with strict security and compliance needs. You’ll focus on developing the team, creating a healthy operating rhythm, and establishing predictable execution for the SSCS SKU.
You’ll join a product area where customers in regulated industries are already validating the need, and your work will help GitLab deliver software supply chain security features that customers can rely on. While technical credibility matters, your main focus will be growing a strong backend engineering team, enabling team members in their development, and creating the conditions for long-term delivery and quality.

What you’ll do

• Guide a backend engineering team building the SSCS Add-On across dependency enforcement, build provenance, malicious package detection, and artifact signing.

• Be responsible forDrive engineering delivery for general availability milestones by aligning sequencing, scope, and dependencies with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager.

• Develop the team by partnering with Talent Acquisition on sourcing, interview design, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.

• Run regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that enable growth and clear expectations.

• Advance engineering quality by monitoring cycle time, defect rates, and test coverage, and by addressing risks early.

• Coordinate quarterly planning and roadmap tradeoff discussions with SSCS stage leadership and Product.

• Work with Finance and other partners on headcount pacing and team planning as the Add-On scales.

• Represent the SSCS Add-On team within stage leadership discussions and help ensure strong communication across functions.

• Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

• Over 3 years of experience guiding backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments.

• Ability to hire and grow backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles.

• Technical credibility to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, CI/CD pipeline security, and signing infrastructure.

• Experience managing predictable delivery across multi-quarter product roadmaps and managing cross-team dependencies.

• Comfort working in an asynchronous, documentation-driven organization with clear written communication.

• Familiarity with supply chain security, artifact management, or compliance-focused product areas, or transferable experience from related domains.

• Working knowledge of concepts related to frameworks and ecosystems such as SLSA and Sigstore.

• Ability to build credibility with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders through clear judgment, coaching, and teamwork.

About the team
The SSCS Add-On team is a product engineering team within GitLab ’s Software Supply Chain Security stage. We work on key capabilities in the SSCS Add-On SKU and collaborate closely with product and engineering partners to deliver security features for customers operating in regulated environments. You’ll report to the SSCS Senior Engineering Manager and partner directly with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. As a distributed team working asynchronously across regions, we are focused on strong delivery practices, team health, and scaling the product area with clarity and accountability. For more on how related teams work, see Team Handbook Page.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Team Member Resource Groups

• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Growth and Development Fund

• Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab ’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab ’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

The CTO organization spans 700+ people across Platform, AI, Engineering, Enterprise Engineering and IT. The Chief of Staff to the CTO is a one-person force multiplier. You own the CTO's time, attention, decisions, and follow-through, and increasingly you build the AI agents that run their operating system.

What you'll do

• Own the CTO's operating system: how their week, preparation, and decisions flow, with a running decision and commitment log so decisions get made once, stick, and each follow-up has a named owner.

• Build and scale AI agents that absorb more of their operating system, freeing your hours for higher-leverage work.

• Run the few things they own that have no organizational home, from framing to clean handoff, without adding process.

Required skills and experience

• 6+ years in BizOps, strategy, consulting, or technical program leadership, including support of a senior technical executive.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication: you can write in an executive's voice and turn technical trade-offs into business terms.

• Technical fluency: you follow architecture, infrastructure, and AI discussions with staff-plus engineers and ask the right questions. You do not need to be a practicing engineer.

• Judgment and discretion with sensitive org, people, and strategy information, and a clear read on what to escalate, decide, or let go.

• Influence without authority across senior engineering and cross-functional leaders, earned by being prepared and useful.

• Personal operating rigor: you track commitments and close loops relentlessly, without building process.

• Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work; experience in a platform, infrastructure, developer tooling, or AI-focused organization is a plus.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

About the team
The Finance Controls team helps management establish and maintain effective internal controls over financial reporting. We partner closely with control owners, Finance and Accounting leaders, Internal Audit, external auditors, Technology and Security teams, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional partners to strengthen the control environment and support reliable financial reporting.

As an Associate Manager, SOX & Internal Controls, you'll own a defined set of business processes within Coinbase's SOX and SOC 1 programs from end to end. Our Internal Controls team keeps Coinbase audit-ready by designing, documenting, and monitoring the controls that safeguard financial reporting across a fast-changing crypto platform. You'll bring a technology lens to controls work, mapping data flows from source systems to financial statements, evaluating automated control evidence, and driving remediation when gaps arise.

What you'll do:

• Own assigned SOX business processes end to end, including process narratives, risk-and-control matrices, key systems, automated controls, and business process controls, keeping each area audit-ready through continuous documentation and design updates.

• Partner with Technology, Engineering, Security Compliance, and Finance Analytics to scope IT general controls and IT application controls, map data flows, and evaluate the reliability of system-generated evidence.

• Lead day-to-day SOX and SOC 1 execution for your area, including risk assessment, scoping, walkthroughs, testing coordination, deficiency evaluation, and remediation tracking with control owners.

• Coordinate audit readiness and information requests with Internal Audit and external auditors, ensuring support is timely, complete, and well organized.

• Advise control owners on control design, evidence quality, and sustainable remediation while helping improve repeatable standards, playbooks, and evidence workflows across the function.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 6+ years in SOX, IT audit, internal controls, controllership, or a closely related controls function, with Big Four or public accounting experience preferred.

• Demonstrated ownership of a business process or controls workstream end to end, from documentation through testing and remediation, in a heavily automated, high-change environment.

• Working knowledge of ITGCs (access, change management, operations), IT application controls, and system-generated reports, with the ability to trace how a system supports a financial process.

• Hands-on experience with data validation across systems using SQL, spreadsheets, or analytics tools to test control logic and verify system output.

• CPA, CISA, CIA, or comparable certification preferred; Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We’re here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows, and rapidly build new secure solutions, using simple no-code tools. We’re revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day’s work.
Smartsheet is looking for a Solutions Architect to drive quality, efficiency and customer satisfaction within our Professional Services’ business by leading customer conversations and assisting customers with developing, building, testing and deploying solutions that leverage Smartsheet, the Smartsheet API and integrations between Smartsheet and other products. The right candidate will have a passion for working with leading edge, web-based, and AI-powered technologies and a desire to deeply understand Smartsheet’s benefits, use cases, and business and technical elements.
As a Solutions Architect, you will work with Smartsheet customers and partners on engagements to convert business requirements into Smartsheet solutions. Within this role, you will be considered the Subject Matter Expert pertaining to advanced Smartsheet functionalities in order to propose solutions for use cases across different industries and business groups. The right candidate is a strong communicator, detail-oriented, and is motivated by both working independently and leading impactful customer conversations.
You will report to the Director, Solution Architect . This is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered.
You Will:

• Develop, build, test and deploy custom software solutions leveraging a wide array of Smartsheet product & third party APIs

• Design and build AI-powered workflows and automations — leveraging LLMs, AI agents, and Smartsheet’s native AI capabilities — to solve customer problems that traditional configuration can’t

• Leverage AI coding assistants such as Claude Code to accelerate custom development, prototyping, and solution delivery across customer engagements

• Evaluate emerging AI tools and techniques and apply them to accelerate time-to-value for customers

• Lead technical consulting engagements that require custom software development by leading design sessions, defining technical requirements, and validating solution architecture against product best practices

• Design and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives

• Partner directly with customer teams throughout an engagement, embedding deeply enough in their workflows to translate real-world pain points into working solutions quickly

• Rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions in close collaboration with customers, refining scope and design based on hands-on feedback rather than waiting for formal review cycles

• Own solutions end-to-end — from initial discovery through deployment, adoption, and ongoing refinement in production

• Build reusable components, frameworks, and accelerators that can be extended and redeployed across future customer engagements

• Serve as the Smartsheet subject matter expert (SME) on Smartsheet product capabilities and AI-powered extensibility scenarios that leverage the API

• Manage all aspects of technical projects, including, but not limited to, the schedule, deliverables, deadlines and client relationships

• Drive the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Smartsheet implementation

• Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role

• Provide feedback to our Product & Platform Engineering teams that inform product improvements and identify feature gaps

• Other duties as assigned

You Have:

• 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and education

• Working experience with two or more of our primary languages (.Net, NodeJS, Python, Java, Ruby)

• Full-stack development skills, with the ability to independently design, build, and ship production-quality applications — not just configure existing tools

• Familiarity with AI/LLM technologies and experience integrating them into applications via APIs

• Working knowledge of prompt engineering and AI agent design patterns, with curiosity for applying AI to solve real business problems

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, with comfort integrating them into a daily engineering workflow

• Willing to travel periodically (up to 15%) based on customer and business need

• Strong communication skills (written, verbal, presentation), with the ability to explain technical subjects to non-technical end user personnel in large enterprises

• Proven ability to drive projects from concept through completion with minimal guidance

• Customer facing experience

• Comfort operating with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where requirements evolve in real time

• A strong bias toward ownership — treating customer problems as your own and staying engaged through to a successful outcome

• Experience rapidly prototyping and iterating on solutions based on direct, hands-on customer feedback

• Experience working with SaaS/IPaaS applications in an enterprise environment

• Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions

• Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume best practices

• Knowledge of data integration and experience integrating SaaS applications with different business systems (ETL, CRM, business analytics, reporting, etc.)

• Bachelors in MIS, CIS, CS preferred but not required

Current US Perks & Benefits:

• Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees

• 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

• Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity

• Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off

• US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans

• US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year

• Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave

• Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community

• Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses

• Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account

• Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range
$127,500 — $165,000 USD

Get to Know Us:

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. About Tailscale
Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role
We’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

• Deliver projects related to pricing plans and billing

• Develop our billing integration with third party services, strengthening our end-to-end billing experience.

• Take ownership of the entire product lifecycle, from writing code to product ideation and strategic decision-making.

• Work closely with UX/UI designers and product managers to shape features.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

• Work as part of a team of engineers to design, build, test, and document core billing software components.

• Integrate with third-party billing platforms (e.g., Stripe, Metronome) as needed

• Develop metering, pricing, and rating logic for usage-based and subscription billing models.

• Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of customer usage data.

• Monitor and maintain billing systems to ensure high availability and data integrity.

• Build automation tools for recurring billing tasks, reconciliation, and reporting.

• Collaborate with product, sales, and finance teams to support custom billing requirements.

• Work closely with finance, product, support, and engineering teams to support accurate billing, revenue reporting, and customer inquiries.

• Act as a technical expert in billing-related discussions and planning.

• Champion engineering excellence by driving code quality, architectural reviews, and design documentation.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers, fostering a culture of learning and knowledge sharing.

• Establish observability, alerting, and error handling across the billing pipeline to ensure high availability and responsiveness.

• Lead incident response and root cause analysis for billing-related issues.

What We Are Looking For

• Experience in backend software engineering, with a strong focus on billing, payments, or financial systems.

• Deep knowledge of SaaS billing models, including subscriptions, usage-based pricing, proration, discounts, and entitlements.

• Proven experience integrating with third-party billing platforms such as Stripe, Metronome, Orb, Zuora, etc, or building custom billing systems.

• Experience designing and managing distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

• Proficient with SQL and data modeling, especially for financial and usage data.

• Solid understanding of APIs and experience building or integrating internal billing APIs.

• Strong proficiency in Go, or comfortable writing production-quality code in another language and eager to work with Go

• Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States - Remote
We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu
Instacart is solving incredibly hard problems and growing, and that growth runs on commercial arrangements with partners, including retailer, partnerships, and vendor agreements. This role exists to work closely with business development, partnerships, product, and operations to solve thorny legal problems and enable the business to scale and grow. Without it, commercial terms and business strategy lack sound legal advice and creative solutions to tough legal problems. A year from now, partner agreements are drafted, negotiated, and implemented across the business, and internal teams have a proactive legal partner who works well cross-functionally.

What you'll cook up in your first year

• Draft, negotiate, and implement major enterprise and partner agreements across all areas of the business

• Lead negotiations with retailers and other strategic partners, aligning internal stakeholders and driving deals to close

• Provide strategic legal advice to internal business clients, including whether to approve, approve with conditions, decline, or escalate

• Lead special legal and cross-functional projects from start to finish

• Implement best practices for integrating AI into your work

• Stay current on advertising, competition, IP, consumer protection, gig economy, international, and privacy laws and regulations, and translate them into practical compliance advice

• Draft terms, policies, and disclosures, and build the processes that support them

• Advise internal clients on the application of executed agreements

• Create and update our form legal agreements and playbooks

• Train clients and colleagues on legal issues

• Think ahead, see around corners, and help the business prepare for future legal issues

The secret ingredients we're looking for
Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

• A J.D. from a top-tier law school and membership with at least one state bar (preferably California)

• A minimum of 6 years of related experience working at a leading law firm or in-house legal department

• Strong experience with legal issues affecting the Internet and e-commerce spaces, particularly privacy, SaaS, and payments

• A strong history of managing strategic partner negotiations and contract drafting from start to finish

• Strong negotiation presence and the ability to lead teams working towards a goal

• Sound and practical business judgment and ability to manage multiple, high priority, competing priorities

• The ability to provide clear, concise legal advice, work effectively cross-functionally to drive to results

• A team player

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

• In-house experience, especially at a tech company or retailer

• Experience in alcohol law, international law, and/or privacy and data security laws (including GDPR and CCPA/CPRA)

• Experience with AI governance and privacy-by-design in ML/AI product development

• Experience in AdTech

Your Recipe for Impact

• Initiative. You take ownership, spot issues before they become problems, and move work forward without waiting to be asked.

• Sound judgment. You know when to approve, approve with conditions, decline, or escalate, and you can explain your reasoning to both lawyers and business stakeholders.

• Cross-functional partnership. You build trusted relationships with business development, partnerships, product, and operations, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment.

• Clear, articulate communication. You make complex legal concepts accessible to non-legal audiences, including senior leadership.

• Fast learning and range. You pick up new products, industries, and legal areas quickly and enjoy a varied docket.

• Creative problem-solving. You think outside the box, are comfortable in ambiguous, novel territory, and find workable solutions beyond the standard playbook.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - ID; Remote - NM; Remote - UT
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.
This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

• 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role

• Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue

• All candidates must be located in one of the following states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah

An ideal candidate has:

• Proven track record of consistent quota achievement

• Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes

• Experience with high-volume cold calling

• Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process

• SFDC familiarity

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.
Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$152,000 — $190,000 USD

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role
As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.
In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

What you'll do

• Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the GitLab monolith (Ruby) and, where needed, the AI Gateway (Python). Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.

• Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.

• Design, implement and review GraphQL and REST APIs and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients.

• Improve and extend automated testing (RSpec and other frameworks) to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.

• Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.

• Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.

• Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class.

What you'll bring

• Experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, including background jobs, APIs and data models.

• Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends is a plus.

• Skill in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.

• Real enthusiasm for AI and hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations is a plus.

• Proven SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and data modeling.

• Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.

• Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Toronto, Ontario - Remote

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:
Gusto’s looking to bring on several Staff Product Designers across our Money and HR Experience product organizations. These teams sit on some of the highest-stakes, most AI-native surfaces at Gusto, where small businesses make financial and people decisions that carry real impact, and where getting the experience right is what builds durable trust. That's exactly why judgment, taste, and craft matter here.
As a Staff Product Designer, you'll own experiences end to end within a specific domain, turning ambiguity into clear, trustworthy products and helping define patterns that don't yet exist at Gusto. You'll be deeply embedded in the product quartet, driving design decisions in partnership with Product Managers and Engineers, and demonstrating high craft and storytelling every step of the way.
This is one job posting for five open roles in Gusto Money, Banking, and HR Experiences product orgs. You'll be matched to the opportunity that best fits your strengths and interests. Here are the teams currently hiring:

• Consumer Banking: Consumer Banking builds financial products for the millions of employees paid through Gusto, anchored to Gusto Wallet — spend accounts, savings goals, paycheck splitting, and on-demand access to earned wages. Because Gusto runs payroll, the team sits at the source of income itself, helping workers smooth cash flow between paychecks, save automatically, and avoid predatory alternatives like payday lenders and overdraft fees. One of the fastest-growing engines in Gusto Banking, it moves at a startup pace while incubating 0→1 foundational technology in a regulated space where trust, reliability, and craft are everything.

• Gusto Money: MoneyOS is the team within Gusto Money focused on helping small businesses better understand, manage, and improve their financial position. This is an especially exciting moment for the team. The space is still taking shape, which means there’s real room to define the product, the patterns, and the customer expectations. MoneyOS works at the intersection of product strategy, financial systems, customer trust, and emerging AI-native ways of building—making it a strong fit for a designer who wants to have outsized influence on both what we build and how we build it.

• HR Experiences (HRX): HRX helps small businesses get expert HR help right inside the product — a customer simply says what they need, and Gusto takes the action, answers the question, or brings in a human expert when the stakes are high. You'll design AI-native experiences across a two-sided service — the everyday self-serve moments, the AI that guides and does the work, and the human HR experts who step in when it matters most — so it all feels like one Gusto, in a domain where judgment and trust matter enormously.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day:

• Own design end to end in your domain — from framing ambiguous problems to shipping high-craft, accessible experiences that hide the underlying complexity from customers.

• Shape goals, priorities, and roadmap in partnership with your PM and engineering lead, balancing customer trust, business value, and technical realities.

• Translate ambiguous, often 0→1 strategy into clear scopes, flows, and interaction patterns — including patterns that don't yet exist at Gusto.

• Design the experience of AI thoughtfully — representing uncertainty, surfacing errors gracefully, preserving customer agency, and knowing when a human should step in.

• Ground your decisions in customer insight, leading or partnering on research, competitive audits, and hypothesis-driven exploration in high-stakes, sometimes compliance-sensitive domains.

• Raise the craft and systems bar, evolving Gusto's design system where existing patterns fall short.

• Work in fast cycles and use AI tools in your own practice — set a clear target, prototype and ship real things to customers, and let what you learn sharpen the direction.

Here's what we're looking for:

• 6+ years of product design experience owning and shipping end-to-end work, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or another high-trust domain, with strong craft across web.

• Experience designing AI-enabled or conversational experiences shipped to real users, and you can speak concretely to how you handled uncertainty, errors, and human override.

• Comfort with ambiguity and 0→1, you frame the problem, scope the work, and move forward without waiting for perfect information.

• Strong systems thinking, you use and contribute to a design system and know when to evolve it.

• Judgment to evaluate and direct AI outputs, when to use them, when to override them, and how to raise the bar, especially where the cost of being wrong is high.

• Strong collaboration and communication across design, product, engineering, and data.

Bonus points

• Experience in a high-stakes or regulated domain, fintech, financial services, HR, compliance, legal, or healthcare.

• Hands-on experience designing AI-driven or agentic product experiences, shaping how an AI or agent behaves, communicates, and hands off to a human.

• Service-design fluency across two-sided or multi-stakeholder products: real journey mapping and blueprinting with operational handoffs, not workshop exercises.

• Helped lead a team's shift to AI-native workflows, and can speak to what changed about the work itself, not just the tools.

• Background contributing to AI governance, evaluation practices, or AI experience design patterns.

Our cash compensation range for this role is $146,000/yr to $183,000/yr in Denver, and $177,000/yr to $222,000/yr in San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.
At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.
Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.
Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.
When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.
Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.
Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:
Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.
With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.
Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.
THE OPPORTUNITY:
At Salesloft, our Senior Business Systems Administrator is a key operational pillar of our enterprise technology strategy. You will be a core member of our high-performing Enterprise Business Systems Team, leading the administration, optimization, and strategic alignment of the Salesforce platform and connected business applications that power our enterprise GTM engine.
While you are a Salesforce expert at heart, your domain extends across our broader GTM tech stack. You are not just managing users and tickets; you are designing scalable architectures, improving user adoption, optimizing business processes, and partnering with cross-functional leadership to enable global growth. You will be responsible for system health, business alignment, integration integrity, and process orchestration across the Salesloft tech stack.
On a day-to-day basis you will:

• Serve as a Lead Salesforce Administrator for Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, executing complex configurations, declarative development, security architecture, environment management, and ongoing maintenance.

• Collaborate directly with business leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to align system capabilities with business goals and build long-term technology roadmaps.

• Act as the strategic bridge between Business Analysts, Business Owners, and Systems Engineers to translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable, and functional technical designs.

• Identify and implement system-driven solutions to optimize business processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual effort

• Establish and enforce standards and procedures for system configuration management to ensure consistency, reliability, and compliance

• 2+ years hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator/Business Analyst

• Salesforce Certification

• Strong understanding of enterprise business systems (e.g., CRM, ERP, HRIS).

• Experience in Sales or Business Operations is a plus

• Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-level business systems.

• Proven experience with system integrations and middleware technologies.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and process optimization skills.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience with business process mapping and documentation.

• Knowledge of system configuration management principles and best practices.

• Ability to define and promote best practices for system usage and administration.

• Project management skills, including planning, execution, and risk management.

• Write SQL and Python against Snowflake and Databricks to build signal logic, scoring, and data products.

• Turn usage, intent, job change, pipeline-trigger, and deal-health signals into Rhythm plays, and measure what they produce.

• Build and run AI agents and automations with logging, guardrails, and a named owner for each one.

• Keep data clean through deduplication, enrichment waterfalls, field governance, and routing hygiene.

• Partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.

• Document everything, so that if you’re out for two weeks, the system keeps running.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE (our values, in this role)

• Move as One: You’ll partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.

• Evidence over Ego: You’ll measure what your plays produce and retire the signals that don’t perform.

• Lead from the Front: You’ll own the systems you build from launch through monitoring, with a named owner for each one, and document them so they keep running when you’re out.

• Make Your Mark: As the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the team, you’ll shape how we turn signals into pipelines and help hire the next GTM Engineer.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You’re a bias-towards-action, results-oriented builder who ships production systems, explains them to a sales leader in plain English, and stays laser-focused on the pipeline. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.
YOU’LL BRING

• 5+ years building in GTM systems (RevOps, marketing ops, sales ops, or GTM engineering), with production builds you can walk us through.

• Strong SQL and working Python or JavaScript, and comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON.

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, plus at least two of: Marketo, LeanData, Salesloft or Outreach, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Snowflake.

• Experience with a workflow or iPaaS tool such as Tines, Tray, Workato, or n8n.

• You’ve shipped something with LLMs or agents that real people rely on every day.

• You can explain a build to a sales leader in plain English and tie it to the pipeline.

IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

• Experience with dbt, reverse ETL (Census, Hightouch), or Databricks.

• Experience with Clay or ZoomInfo GTM Studio.

• You’ve been through a merger or a CRM migration.

• A background in marketing ops or RevOps before moving into engineering.

THE TEAM
You’ll be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering. We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, so you’ll have real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline. You’ll hear “Yes, let’s do that!” and then have the opportunity to execute on your ideas.

• 8+ years of enterprise software, SaaS, cybersecurity, identity, cloud, or infrastructure sales experience, including 3–5 years leading quota-carrying sales teams.

• A consistent record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets and developing net-new enterprise logos through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

• Territories have executable account plans linking priority accounts to business hypotheses, buying signals, executive relationships, partner coverage, and next actions.

jobs.title: Manager, FP&A - Corporate Reporting & Cash
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote United States
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.
Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced FP&A professional to play a central role in our corporate planning, reporting, and cash forecasting processes. This Manager-level role will bring together the consolidated financial outlook and help ensure Finance has a clear, consistent view of company performance across the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow.
The role will own key corporate FP&A deliverables, including consolidated forecasting, cash flow modeling and forecasting, Board and ELT reporting, PE sponsor and portfolio company reporting, and GAAP-to-non-GAAP bridges.
Our approach to FP&A is simple: understand what happened, determine why it matters, and help the business decide what to do next.
In this role, that means taking inputs from across the FP&A organization and translating them into an accurate, coherent company-level view of performance and outlook. This person will work closely across FP&A, Accounting, Treasury, and the broader Office of the CFO, with significant exposure to senior leadership.
What You’ll Do
Corporate FP&A & consolidation

• Own the consolidation of company forecasts and financial outlooks, bringing together inputs across the FP&A organization into a cohesive company view.

• Maintain an integrated understanding of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow and how changes in one area affect the others.

• Analyze company-level performance, risks, opportunities, and changes in outlook. Make recommendations to the business and ELT on ways to improve operational and financial performance.

• Ensure consolidated reporting is accurate, internally consistent, and aligned across FP&A and Accounting.

• Support annual planning, rolling forecasts, long-range planning, and other corporate planning processes.

• Strengthen controls, documentation, and repeatability around core FP&A reporting and consolidation processes.

• Maintain and evolve integrated three-statement models, with particular ownership of balance-sheet forecasting and the linkages between operating performance, working capital, cash flow, and ending cash.

• Contribute to the company’s long-range planning process by translating operating assumptions into multi-year P&L, balance-sheet, cashflow, and free-cash-flow outcomes and helping assess longer-term financial trajectory.

• Own the company cash flow forecast and underlying model, connecting P&L performance, working capital, capital expenditures, financing activity, and other cash movements.

• Develop clear bridges between EBITDA, operating cash flow, free cash flow, and changes in cash.

• Partner with Accounting, Treasury, and FP&A business partners to understand collections, payment timing, accruals, deferred revenue, commissions, and other working-capital drivers.

• Identify emerging cash risks and opportunities and incorporate them into the forward outlook.

• Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses around key cash flow assumptions.

• Improve the predictability and transparency of cash generation and the drivers of free cash flow.

Executive, Board & sponsor reporting

• Support periodic reporting to the Board as well as taking a lead role in preparing Board materials and ad hoc analysis

• Coordinate and prepare recurring financial reporting for ELT and the Board, bringing together financial results, forecasts, KPIs, and supporting analysis into a clear and consistent narrative.

• Own recurring PE sponsor and portfolio company reporting requirements and coordinate inputs across Finance.

• Develop financial bridges and analyses that explain changes in performance and outlook.

• Maintain consistency between internal management reporting, Board reporting, sponsor reporting, and the underlying financial forecast.

• Support ad hoc financial analysis and reporting for the CFO and senior Finance leadership.

GAAP to non-GAAP & financial integrity

• Own and maintain key bridges between GAAP financial results and the non-GAAP measures used to manage and communicate the business.

• Partner closely with accounting to ensure adjustments are complete, accurate, documented, and applied consistently.

• Maintain clear support for Adjusted EBITDA and other management reporting measures.

• Understand and explain differences between reported results, management reporting, and the operating forecast.

• Help ensure financial definitions and reporting methodologies remain consistent across FP&A deliverables.

Corporate reporting rhythm, AI, and Automation

• Coordinate inputs and timelines across FP&A for monthly, quarterly, forecast, Board, and sponsor reporting.

• Identify inconsistencies or gaps across business-partner forecasts and work with the team to resolve them before consolidation.

• Drive process improvements and automation across recurring FP&A workflows, using AI and other tools to reduce manual effort and improve the speed, consistency, and quality of reporting and analysis.

• Maintain a strong standard of accuracy and attention to detail while articulating the company-level financial story through financial and related operational data

What You’ll Bring

• Approximately 5–8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, or a related role.

• Experience in a $300M–$1B PE-backed or pre-IPO enterprise B2B SaaS business, or a highly comparable environment.

• Strong three-statement financial modeling and cash flow forecasting experience.

• Demonstrated experience with corporate FP&A, including consolidation and executive-level financial reporting.

• Strong understanding of the relationship between the P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and working capital.

• Experience preparing Board, executive, investor, or PE sponsor financial reporting.

• Fluency in GAAP and non-GAAP reporting and experience maintaining or explaining reconciliations between the two.

• Strong Excel and financial modeling skills with high standards for accuracy and financial integrity.

• Ability to synthesize inputs from multiple areas into a concise company-level financial story.

• High-judgement and tolerance for ambiguity. Thrives in fast-paced, highly dynamic PE-backed SaaS environment.

• Strong communication and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple recurring deliverables with tight deadlines.

Better Together
Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.
We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.
About Us
BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.
BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.
Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com .

Strategic Finance provides the analytical rigor and data-driven insight that drives decisions across PagerDuty. PagerDuty is looking for a Senior Manager to serve as the primary finance business partner for our go-to-market organization. Reporting to our Country Manager, Japan, you'll work across account management, customer success, marketing, product, engineering, and operations to deliver a consistent, high-quality experience for GitLab customers and expand our footprint. • Review pipeline, forecast, and performance data to identify gaps and opportunities, adjust regional plans to focus on priority activities, and represent the Japan business internally with clear insights on market trends and customer needs.

About Ping Identity:
At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.
Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.
While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.
We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Ping is continuing its significant global expansion, and we need a key member to join our UK Finance team to help prepare the organization and the Controllership function for scale. As a Finance Assistant, you'll be instrumental in ensuring the efficiency and accuracy of our core operational finance processes, providing a platform for continued success and personal growth.
If you are detail-oriented, love process improvement, and want to see your work directly support a massive growth trajectory, this is the place for you.

What You Will Do: Key Responsibilities
You will manage critical daily financial operations while contributing to system and process improvements across the UK and global operations.

Accounts Payable (AP) & Vendor Management

• Process Efficiency: Accurately enter and process Accounts Payable (AP) vendor invoices from our global operations.

• Payment & Control: Assist with the preparation of global payment runs and actively monitor the AP inbox to ensure timely processing and issue resolution.

• Risk Mitigation: Strictly maintain vendor onboarding controls and bank change validations to mitigate the risk of financial fraud.

• Dispute Resolution: Research and resolve discrepancies arising from vendor disputes, payment differences, and invoice reconciliations, ensuring high vendor satisfaction.

• Internal Service: Provide excellent customer service to internal company departments involved in the end-to-end AP process.

Travel & Expense (T&E) Administration

• Policy Compliance: Review and verify employee travel and business expenses, ensuring strict alignment with Ping’s global Travel & Expense policy.

• Employee Experience: Assist with T&E queries, ensuring timely responses.

Accounting & Operational Excellence

• Complete weekly cash flow forecast covering planned AP and expense payments.

• Complete reconciliations of actual payments vs forecast on a weekly basis.

• Build future medium term AP and expense payments forecasts supporting company cash flow forecasting.

What You Bring: Qualifications

Essential Experience & Skills

• 3+ years of experience in an Accounts Payable (AP) or operational Procurement role, preferably within a global or multi-entity environment.

• Proven experience with employee expense policy verification and processing.

• Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

• A collaborative personality with outstanding verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Experience

• Direct experience with major financial systems (e.g., Coupa, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite).

• Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, data manipulation).

Life at Ping:
We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.
Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

• A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.

jobs.title: Product User Research, Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT SARVAM AI

Sarvam AI is building India's sovereign AI stack, spanning foundational models, infrastructure and applications. Our mission is to make powerful AI accessible and useful for India, building technology that works across languages, industries and real-world use cases.

As we continue to build and scale our products, understanding how people interact with them becomes increasingly important. We're looking for a curious and research-oriented intern to help us understand our users better and shape the experiences we build.



THE ROLE

As a Product User Research Intern, you'll work closely with our product, design and engineering teams to understand user behaviour, identify friction points and uncover opportunities to improve our products.

You'll interact directly with developers, product managers and founders, study how they use Sarvam's products, and translate your findings into actionable insights that influence product and design decisions.

This is an opportunity to work on a new user research function at Sarvam, helping establish research practices and processes from the ground up. You'll also get ownership of a primary product area and the opportunity to see your research translate into real product improvements.



WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Understand our users: Conduct user interviews, surveys and usability studies with developers, PMs and founders to understand their needs, behaviours and challenges.

 - Improve product experiences: Research user journeys across Sarvam's developer console, playground, API documentation and applications. Identify friction points across onboarding, API key creation, first API calls, billing and other key workflows.

 - Study developer journeys: Analyse the developer funnel, from sign-up to making the first API call and eventually becoming a paying user. Understand where users drop off and, more importantly, why.

 - Test and evaluate designs: Conduct usability testing on existing interfaces and new prototypes, run preference and A/B tests, and benchmark experiences against other developer products.

 - Turn research into insights: Analyse qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns and present clear recommendations to product, design, growth and support teams.

 - Build the research practice: Help establish research playbooks, interview templates, participant recruitment processes and a research repository that can scale with the team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong curiosity about user behaviour and a genuine interest in understanding why people use products the way they do.

 - Comfortable speaking with users, conducting interviews and asking thoughtful, unbiased questions.

 - Technical fluency — you should be comfortable reading API documentation, making basic API calls using tools like Postman, curl or Python, and understanding what might have gone wrong when an API fails.

 - Comfortable working with data, analysing spreadsheets and interpreting product funnels or dashboards.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate research findings into clear insights and recommendations.

 - Familiarity with AI tools and developer products, and an interest in exploring how they can improve research workflows.


GOOD TO HAVE

 - Experience with SQL or product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or Metabase.

 - Familiarity with user research methodologies, usability testing and survey design.

 - Experience reviewing Figma prototypes or conducting user interviews.

 - Previous research projects, internships or personal projects involving products you've built or shipped.

 - Fluency in one or more Indian languages.


WHO CAN APPLY?

 - Final-year students or graduates who have completed their studies within the last 12 months.

 - Candidates from engineering, psychology, economics, design or social science backgrounds.

 - Individuals who can commit to a full-time, 6-month, in-office internship in Bengaluru.


WHAT YOU'LL GET

 - The opportunity to help build Sarvam's user research function from the ground up.

 - Direct exposure to product, design and engineering teams working on India's sovereign AI ecosystem.

 - Hands-on experience researching developer products and real-world AI applications.

 - Ownership of meaningful research projects with findings that directly influence product decisions.

 - An opportunity to work closely with experienced product leaders and learn how research translates into better products.

 - Potential for a pre-placement offer (PPO) based on performance.

About the Team
As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, you'll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Together, we create tools that help developers build faster, more intuitively, and with greater impact. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.
With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.
We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions.Â With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.
This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater
In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.
Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.
You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.
You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

• Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.

• Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.

• Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.

• Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.

• Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.

• Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.

• Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

TELUS Digital AI Community
Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.
Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

Basic Requirements

• Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.

• Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.

• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.

• Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.

• Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification

• Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.

• High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.

• Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.

• Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.

• Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

Equal Opportunity
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.
